relevance.rationale: *** WRONG JOIN ***. The seeded id points at a two-author 1994 quantum-dilogarithm entry. The document's own title page shows a SINGLE-author paper from a different year on a different topic - a quantum-dilogarithm-based knot invariant in integral form (arXiv:math-ph/0105039v1). Author set, year and subject all differ from the seeded entry, so the join is wrong. No registered key matches it: references.ts carries entries for this author's math-ph/0405028 and math/0403224 papers only, and a grep for '0105039' in references.ts is empty. id set to null. Judged on its own merits the document sits squarely in the folio's subject area: it studies a non-compact analogue of the Kashaev / colored-Jones invariant defined by an integral, and shows the hyperbolicity gluing-consistency conditions arise in the classical limit as the SADDLE-POINT equation of that integral. The corpus runs a large state-integral / saddle-point programme (QOU/QBeta/StateIntegralRecursionLattice.lean, QOU/QBeta/PhibSaddleA1Exact.lean, mass-endomorphism/complex-volume-character-variety-path.md), so this is usable background; I could not identify a specific corpus statement it discharges, so supporting rather than core.
